prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Carousel Layout Redesign: Redesign the onboarding story screen using a interactive carousel layout to showcase desktop pet features.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Discover Your Desktop Companion"}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Personality Quiz New Screen: Introduce a new quick personality quiz screen prior to pet creation to help users choose the right companion trait.
   config: {"new_pet_quiz": {"headline": "Match Your Pet Personality", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select Temperament"}]}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Checklist Layout Redesign: Rebuild the adoption certificate screen into a clear checklist layout showing summary details before finalizing.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Finalize Pet Registration"}}
3: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Story Scroll Redesign: Transform the pet generation waiting screen into a story scroll layout highlighting pet lore while processing.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Your Companion Is Awakening"}}
4: [choose_path, new_flow] Path Selection Interactive Preview Subflow: Add a visual subflow screen that lets users preview how different companion paths interact on the desktop background.
   config: {"new_path_preview": {"headline": "Explore Companion Types", "layout": "full_bleed", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:path_preview"}]}}
5: [sign_in, layout] Sign In Stage Layout Upgrade: Upgrade the sign-in screen layout to a stage view that highlights account backup benefits clearly.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Sign In to Save Your Pet Progress"}}
6: [finish, copy] Desktop Control Quick Guide Headline Copy: Update headline and body on the final screen with clear instructions on right-clicking and tray controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Ready! Right-Click to Control or Hide", "body": "Use the desktop system tray icon or right-click your pet anytime to open controls, change settings, or talk."}}
7: [home, wait_info] Generation Stage Progress Wait Info: Enable explicit progress status bar and time estimates on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "headline": "Preparing Desktop Pet Assets"}}
8: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality Upload Guidelines Hint: Display explicit photo quality guidance hints on the photo upload screen to prevent generation flaws.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Upload well-lit, front-facing photos for optimal 3D pet model generation."}}
9: [home, notification] Background Ready Desktop Notification Toggle: Add an optional system notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet generation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "body": "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready to spawn."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the story screen using a carousel layout while maintaining its core function of introducing the pet.
Adds a new pet personality quiz screen inside onboarding, which is permitted under Rule 4.
Rebuilding the adoption certificate into a registration checklist fails to show the adoption with an official stamp.
Redesigns the waiting screen to a story scroll layout while preserving its job of showing the pet is being created.
Adds a new visual preview sub-flow within onboarding, which is allowed under Rule 4.
Upgrades the sign-in screen layout while retaining the sign-in functionality.
Updates headline and body copy on the home_intro screen within allowed onboarding modifications.
Adds progress bar and time estimate to the waiting screen for a real wait process, allowed by Rules 4 and 5.
Displays photo quality guidance hints on the photo upload screen without changing functionality.
Adds an optional notification toggle to the waiting screen as allowed by Rule 4.
